snippet.description:
Punch-Out!! was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in  1990. All audio/visual elements copyright 1990, Nintendo. Music composed by ?

No save-states or other cheats were used in this video. It was captured from an original NES console from the red and yellow RCA a/v ports on the side.

-----------

ABOUT PUNCH-OUT!! (NES)

When the contract licensing the use of Mike Tyson's name in the console version expired, Nintendo removed Mike Tyson from the game re-releasing it as Punch-Out!! Otherwise, this release is exactly the same as the original release "Mike Tyson's Punch Out!!".

AKA: Punch-Out!!, パンチアウト!!
